OpenLF2

A playable, open-source reimplementation of Little Fighter 2 v2.0a — the same fast, side-view fighting gameplay, with support for mods.

Play in your browser View source on GitHub

What you can play

OpenLF2 is under active development. Some behavior and platform builds are not yet verified against the original game.

Game modes

Versus, Stage, Battle, Championship, Team Championship, and Demo.

Controls

Keyboard and controller play, with touch controls on supported screens.

Music & replays

In-game music, recordings, and replays.

Network play

Network matches between OpenLF2 players over TCP; original LF2 compatibility is not supported.

Moddable

Gameplay and UI are written in Lua. Mods can extend or replace supported modules through the same versioned script API the base game uses.

MIT-licensed

OpenLF2's code, scripts, and documentation are MIT-licensed. This does not cover the original game, its executable, or its assets.

Play in your browser

This build runs entirely on your device. Select your own LF2_v2.0a.exe installer below to load the original game data. Your browser saves the selected file for future visits; it is never uploaded anywhere.

Need the installer? Download LF2 v2.0a from the Internet Archive, then select the downloaded file below.
